invariants.note: Paginated content fragments through CSS multicol in both writing modes, so a page boundary is a fragmentation break and can never fall inside a line box. Asserted per engine by scripts/conformance/run-pagination-conformance.mjs.
Column size plus column gap must equal one viewport along the paging axis, or the next page bleeds into the current one.
